goal.outcome: Each session's browser tools drive the pane visible in its own session view: open/navigate load the caller's visible address bar, reads/clicks/typing act on that view's webview even when other sessions' hidden webviews exist, screenshots time out cleanly instead of hanging; cookie files remain per calling workspace
criteria: Pane selection maps the caller's pane via the window's visible address bar URL (normalized match across the window's webviews); the no-pane path opens through the visible bar and identifies the spawned/navigated webview correctly with multiple webviews present

Explicit targetId must be the caller's own pane; browser_screenshot has a bounded timeout with a clear error; unit tests cover multi-webview selection, restore-screen (bar value but no webview), targetId refusal, screenshot timeout; node --test passes

Live verification: two sessions in one window each open different URLs in their own visible pane; switching views shows each its own page; screenshot succeeds in the displayed view and errors within the timeout on a hidden pane
README and docs/DETAIL.md describe the per-session-view pane model and per-workspace cookie files accurately
